scope.method: Explicit content/header/README/code-based decisions. Nested archives and geodatabase logical layers inspected; source files unchanged.

rows.evidence: The RAR payload contains SNAPP_Fish_Data.gdb. The catch layer has 198 features, BL1/BL2/BL3/BL4 identifiers, 20 taxon catch fields and TonTot; the package EML identifies the fisheries data and paper.
rows.limitations: The native geodatabase was inspected from a temporary working copy. Historical maximum aggregation and units follow the supplied description and provenance; they were not independently recomputed. test.rar is a hash-identical copy of DATAnull.

assets.selector: SNAPP_Fish_Data.gdb / Twenty_principal_comercial_taxa_catch; 198 features; taxon columns and TonTot

rows.evidence: Four inspected scenario CSVs contain sub-daily VPD, RH, temperature, pressure and humidity for SSP126/245/370/585. Their header dictionary specifies 2015-2100 and kPa for VPD.
rows.limitations: The critical threshold and derived counts of extreme VPD days were not identified. Historical forcing files are supporting inputs. Samples include RH above 100% and negative VPD; retain source values and verify QC and units before reuse. The header unit is not independently validated.

rows.evidence: The nested Embrapa/Ducke CSV contains daily weather and SPI_180D_20YCAL_GAMMA. Its header defines SPI using precipitation and 1980-1999 calibration.
rows.limitations: SPI is not SPEI; potential evapotranspiration and a SPEI column were not identified. The weather/SPI file is retained in unmatched local data and linked here as a candidate different product.

rows.evidence: BIONTE_mortality-rates_1991-2019.csv contains 29 annual rows and mortality-rate columns for treatments T0-T3 and blocks.
rows.limitations: Growth, wood density and biomass observations described in the sheet were not identified.

rows.evidence: The Gimenez archive has 41 leaf-temperature and 35 sap-velocity CSVs, with field metadata and instrument manuals. Samples and metadata identify observations during 2015-2017.
rows.limitations: No 2023 measurements, soil moisture or stem/soil water-potential measurements were identified. Separate leaf-water-potential, stomatal-conductance and radiation observations are additional local products.

rows.evidence: The archive contains wetlands_GOC_lat20k_0_voronoi.tif; _8SPAnew2024_polygonize.R explicitly converts the corresponding raster into polygon output.
rows.limitations: The requested final polygons were not found in the supplied archives. A raster and the transformation code are present; the polygonization has not been run.

rows.evidence: The archive contains rivers_GOC_lattice_35_voronoi.tif; _8SPAnew2024_polygonize.R explicitly converts the corresponding raster into polygon output.
rows.limitations: The requested final polygons were not found in the supplied archives. A raster and the transformation code are present; the polygonization has not been run.

rows.evidence: resLand_EPSG5641.tif is present in the resistance-analysis archive and is explicitly generated by _2SPAnew2024_Resistance_analysis.R; river and wetland variants are also supplied.
rows.limitations: Match is established from the named raster and generating script. Scientific impact coefficients, pixel values and all model calculations have not been independently validated.

rows.evidence: The archive contains land_GOC_lattice_225_voronoi.tif; _8SPAnew2024_polygonize.R explicitly converts the corresponding raster into polygon output.
rows.limitations: The requested final polygons were not found in the supplied archives. A raster and the transformation code are present; the polygonization has not been run. For terrestrial connectivity, the full centroid/kernel-density product and the stated 56 km spacing have not been independently confirmed.

rows.evidence: The README explicitly distinguishes the original 716-plot compilation from filtered data. Table_S1/S3 contain 211 terra-firme plots; Table_S5 supplies the 190-species by 211-plot capture matrix.
rows.limitations: The complete original 716-plot, 646-species capture compilation is not supplied. Use signed coordinates in Table_S1; Table_S3 uses absolute latitude in analysis. Species-trait and range-map tables are additional products, not raw captures.

rows.evidence: The README names the paper. Amazon and Napo input tables encode connectivity criteria; two Napo solution tables retain the matching objective. Headers distinguish node, dam and portfolio values.
rows.limitations: These are numerical optimization inputs and portfolio outputs. No spatial dam/network join was supplied, and equivalence to all metrics, units, normalization and basin coverage in the sheet is not fully established. Amazon input has 509 dam edges; Napo has 24. Solutions are Napo-only.
